entities.summary: Isaac Jones is an American professional basketball player for the Detroit Pistons of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Motor City Cruise of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Wenatchee Valley Knights, the Idaho Vandals and the Washington State Cougars.
